description: Migration script for version 5.4.0 of OrangeHRM, handling database schema updates, language string updates, module registration, OAuth2 table creation, and configuration adjustments.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database migration tasks for OrangeHRM version 5.4.0, including schema updates, language string management, module registration, OAuth2 setup, and configuration adjustments.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps: updates language strings, registers modules, sets password policies, creates tables, and configures OAuth2.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database to the specified version.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance.

methods.name: modifyDefaultRequiredPasswordStrength
methods.description: Adjusts the default required password strength configuration based on current settings.

methods.name: modifyDefaultPasswordEnforcement
methods.description: Adjusts the password strength enforcement configuration.

methods.name: createOAuth2Tables
methods.description: Creates OAuth2 related tables and inserts initial OAuth2 client configuration, including encryption keys and token TTLs.

methods.name: changePermissionForAttendanceConfigurationAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the attendance configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForTimeConfigPeriodAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the time sheet configuration API data group.

methods.name: changePermissionForEmployeeWorkShiftAPI
methods.description: Sets permissions for the employee work shift API data group.
